subject: Payment routing preferences and VAT/tax information for BrightByte
messages:
From: Zoey Chen <zoey@brightbyte.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Billing preferences / VAT for Redwood invoices

Hi Marcus,

Quick question as we finalize procurement paperwork for the pilot: can you confirm how Redwood will deliver invoices once we go live? Our AP team prefers invoices to be pushed into our billing portal rather than emailed, but we can accept emailed PDFs if portal delivery isn't available.

Also, do your invoices include a VAT line by default if a VAT number is provided, or do we need a specific tax-exempt flag on file? BrightByte is VAT-registered in the EU and we want to make sure the invoices meet local regulations.

Can you also confirm the billing contact/email we should send PO and remittance instructions to?

Thanks — appreciate the quick clarify.

Zoey Chen
Head of Procurement
BrightByte Analytics
zoey@brightbyte.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Zoey Chen <zoey@brightbyte.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 11:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Billing preferences / VAT for Redwood invoices

Hi Zoey —

Thanks for the note. Short answers below and Ive looped in Monica (Finance) and Laura (Customer Success) to handle setup.

- Invoice delivery: We support both. Preferred is to configure portal delivery (push) so invoices show up directly in your AP system. If you prefer email PDFs, we can do that as a fallback.
- VAT/Tax lines: We will include the VAT line when you provide a VAT number at onboarding; Finance will ensure the invoice layout meets EU VAT requirements. If you need zero-rated or exempt treatment, Monica will confirm the specific flag we require.
- Billing contact: For legal/invoices please send PO and remittance to billing@brightbyte.com, and CC billing@redwood.com as a temporary measure while portal setup completes.

Monica — can you confirm the exact fields you need from BrightByte (VAT, country code, billing address) and whether a signed W-9 or equivalent is required for the portal?

Zoey — attaching our invoice template and a copy of our W-9 for your records.

Cheers,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.com
Attachment: invoice_template.pdf (PDF)
Attachment: W9_Redwood.pdf (PDF)

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Zoey Chen <zoey@brightbyte.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Billing preferences / VAT for Redwood invoices

Hi Zoey, Marcus —

Thanks for looping me in. For a clean portal push and correct VAT handling we need the following from BrightByte:

1) Legal billing name and full billing address (line items + country).
2) VAT registration number (format + issuing country).
3) Registered company number (if applicable).
4) Remittance instructions and preferred currency (USD/EUR).

If BrightByte is EU VAT-registered and providing a valid VAT number, we will:
- Include the VAT number on the invoice header.
- Show VAT as a separate line item per EU invoicing norms.
- Use reverse-charge wording only if you confirm the transaction is B2B and provide the appropriate intra-EU codes.

Portal setup notes:
- We can push invoices to SFTP, an invoice ingestion API, or HubSpot billing connectors. Please tell us which method your AP system prefers and well coordinate credentials.
- If your AP team prefers email for the first 1-2 invoices to validate format, we can do that and then flip the switch to portal push.

No W-9 required for EU entity; W-9 attached is for US tax reporting on our side if you need it. For vendor setup we typically ask for a completed onboarding form (Ill send a short link).

Laura — please coordinate the timing of the portal push with the pilot start so invoicing aligns with go-live.

Best,
Monica Patel
Senior Finance Manager | Redwood Inference
monica@redwood.com
Attachment: onboarding_form_link (https://app.redwood.ai/forms/billing-onboard/BB-2026-0457)

Following up to confirm next steps so we can close the procurement loop this week:

1) If you can reply with the three items Monica listed (legal name, billing address, VAT number) I will provision a portal endpoint and coordinate the first invoice push for the pilot invoice (estimated Monday 6/15).
2) If BrightByte wants the first invoice by email for validation, confirm and well send the PDF to billing@brightbyte.com and cc billing@redwood.com.
3) For SFTP/API delivery, please send the endpoint and a contact for credentials exchange — we can support FTPS/SFTP and a simple webhook that accepts attachments (we will provide a test file).

Ill keep Marcus in the loop about timing and once we have the portal endpoint Ill share the test invoice ID so your AP can verify.
